You need a monitored model endpoint for your education business, and the projects below are the closest matches from my portfolio.

On Model serving platform for a SaaS client I used FastAPI, Docker, AWS and brought p95 inference latency down to 120 ms.

On Defect detection on a packaging line for a logistics client I used Computer vision, PyTorch, Docker and caught 96% of defects at 30 frames per second.

I have also worked with MLflow on other client projects.

I can start this week. Would a 20 minute call suit you to confirm scope and milestones?
